01 The forge

The forge never cools.

No controls, no panel. The agents frame a production module, typeset it, rule its hairlines — then sweep a dashed selection marquee across it and draft the next. Tap anywhere on the board to summon the nearest agent.

02 The pantheon

Eight agents. One discipline each.

Each cursor claims the work it was made for — boxes, type, hairlines, media — and travels along a bowed, minimum-jerk trajectory instead of a straight robotic line.

I · Fire-bringer Lead architect

Prome­theus

Frames every surface with a crosshair and snaps it to the grid. He stole the fire; the rest only follow the light.
